CONVERSATION.NAME: Get Dylan to Apologize
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Dylan ruined his chances at getting his music heard by humiliating Megan. Get him to apologize to her.
CONFIDENCE-Restore Dylan's confidence in his music so he doesn't blow it again.
GUILT-Give Dylan some guilt over what he did to Megan.

CARD.NAME: Did you see her crying?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: How could you laugh while Megan was crying?

CARD.NAME: Guilt Trip
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You're an expert in the guilt trip, all your cards that increase guilt are stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of guilt,

CARD.NAME: I loved your mix
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Your mix CD was awesome, don't you want more people to hear it?

CARD.NAME: Megan deserves better
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Megan is such a sweet girl, she deserves better.

CARD.NAME: Motivational Speaker
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Your words are inspiring, all your dialog that adds to confidence is stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of confident,

CARD.NAME: Secret: Dylan gives his mix CD to all the girls
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You always hand your music to the girls you like because that's how you communicate best. You missed a chance to share that with everyone.

CARD.NAME: Secret: Megan was going to help
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Megan was going to give you a big break, a shot at greatness, and you totally blew it.

CARD.NAME: Secret: You knew Megan was trying to help
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You knew Megan was trying to help you, and you pissed her off on purpose. Why ruin your chances at fame?

CARD.NAME: Secret: Your cheated on Megan
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Haven't you done enough to poor Megan?

CARD.NAME: Secret: Your dad said you were nothing
CARD.DESCRIPTION: It's not true, what your dad said, he was just bitter. You're so talented, I wish you'd see that.

CARD.NAME: Why people like you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dylan, people like you for who you are, not for your pranking.

CARD.NAME: Carefree
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dylan is hard to guilt. All his cards that reduce guilt are stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of guilt,

CARD.NAME: It's a hard knock life.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The music business is cut throat, full of sharks and users. Everyone's lookin' out for number one.

CARD.NAME: Keeping it real.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I make my music for me, it's a pure thing. I don't need some hotshot telling me how to do what I do.

CARD.NAME: Megan knows I was joking
CARD.DESCRIPTION: She knows I kid around, we used to do pranks together!

CARD.NAME: My pranks are funny!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Didn't you see everyone laughing in the club?

CARD.NAME: My sound is not that original
CARD.DESCRIPTION: There's a dozen other guys who sound like me. None as good looking, though, I'll give you that.

CARD.NAME: People b.s. me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Everyone says to my face that my stuff is good, but it seems they are just saying that because they don't have the guts to tell me what they really think.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Megan has a thing for me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Megan has a good sense of humor, I think she's mad because she's still in love with me.

CARD.NAME: Self Deprecating
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Dylan isn't feeling too good about himself right now, all his dialog that reduces confidence is stronger.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of confident,

CARD.NAME: Tuff Luv wouldn't have listened anyway
CARD.DESCRIPTION: He wouldn't have liked my music anyway. For all the game I talk, I know it's really nothing special.
